name: User
description: Store user information for support agents, managers, and end users with authentication and role-based access control

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: end_user, agent, or manager

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: isAvailable
fields.description: Agent availability status for ticket assignment (applicable to agents only)

fields.name: currentWorkload
fields.description: Number of active tickets assigned to agent (applicable to agents only)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

name: Category
description: Define ticket categories for classification and routing with SLA configurations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Category name (e.g., Hardware, Software, Network, Access)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the category scope and coverage

fields.name: defaultPriority
fields.description: Default priority level for tickets in this category (Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: slaResponseTime
fields.description: SLA response time in hours for this category

fields.name: slaResolutionTime
fields.description: SLA resolution time in hours for this category

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this category is currently active and available for ticket assignment

name: Priority
description: Defines priority levels with associated SLA timeframes and escalation rules for IT support tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the priority level

fields.name: name
fields.description: Priority level name (e.g., Critical, High, Medium, Low)

fields.name: level
fields.description: Numeric priority ranking (1=highest, 4=lowest) for sorting

fields.name: slaResponseMinutes
fields.description: SLA timeframe in minutes for initial response

fields.name: slaResolutionMinutes
fields.description: SLA timeframe in minutes for ticket resolution

fields.name: escalationThresholdMinutes
fields.description: Time in minutes before automatic escalation triggers

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this priority level is currently active

name: StatusHistory
description: Records every status transition for IT support tickets with timestamp, user, and audit details for compliance and analytics

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the status history record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket that had a status change

fields.name: previousStatus
fields.description: Status before the change (e.g., Open, In Progress, Pending)

fields.name: newStatus
fields.description: Status after the change (e.g., In Progress, Resolved, Closed)

fields.name: changedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who made the status change

fields.name: changedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the status change occurred

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Optional notes or reason for the status change

relationships.description: Links to the user who made the status change

indexes.description: Optimize queries for ticket status history timeline
Optimize queries for user activity tracking

constraints.newStatusRequired: New status must be provided for every status change
constraints.validTimestamp: Changed at timestamp must not be in the future

name: Comment
description: Store comments and updates in ticket conversation threads

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket this comment belongs to

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: content
fields.description: The comment text content

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Whether the comment is internal (visible only to agents) or public (visible to requester)

fields.name: isSystemGenerated
fields.description: Whether the comment was automatically generated by the system

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is authored by one user

indexes.name: idx_comment_ticket
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order

indexes.name: idx_comment_author
indexes.description: Optimize queries for comments by a specific author

name: Assignment
description: Track ticket assignment history and current ownership with timestamps, assignment reasons, and acceptance status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the assignment record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket being assigned

fields.name: assignedToUserId
fields.description: Reference to the agent/user receiving the assignment

fields.name: assignedByUserId
fields.description: Reference to the user who made the assignment (null for auto-assignments)

fields.name: assignedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the assignment was made

fields.name: assignmentReason
fields.description: Reason for assignment (e.g., 'auto-assigned', 'manual-reassignment', 'workload-balance')

fields.name: acceptanceStatus
fields.description: Status of assignment acceptance (e.g., 'pending', 'accepted', 'rejected')

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if this is the current active assignment for the ticket

indexes.description: Quick lookup of active assignment for a ticket
Query active assignments by agent for workload analysis

constraints.uniqueActiveAssignment: Only one assignment per ticket can have isActive=true at a time

name: SLATracking
description: Monitor SLA compliance and breach status for tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for SLA tracking record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket being tracked

fields.name: responseDeadline
fields.description: Deadline for initial response to ticket

fields.name: resolutionDeadline
fields.description: Deadline for ticket resolution

fields.name: responseBreached
fields.description: Indicates if response SLA has been breached

fields.name: resolutionBreached
fields.description: Indicates if resolution SLA has been breached

fields.name: warningThresholdPercent
fields.description: Percentage of time elapsed before warning alert (e.g., 80)

fields.name: escalated
fields.description: Indicates if ticket has been escalated due to SLA risk

relationships.description: Each SLA tracking record belongs to one ticket

name: Notification
description: Store and manage notification queue for users across multiple channels with delivery and read status tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the recipient user

fields.name: type
fields.description: Notification type (ticket_assigned, status_changed, comment_added, sla_warning, etc.)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel (email, in_app, sms, push)

fields.name: content
fields.description: Notification message content

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status (pending, sent, failed, delivered)

fields.name: isRead
fields.description: Whether the notification has been read by the user

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was created

name: Ticket
description: Central entity storing core ticket information and tracking the complete ticket lifecycle from submission to closure

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue or request

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue, request, or problem

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g., open, in_progress, resolved, closed)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (e.g., low, medium, high, critical)

fields.name: submitterId
fields.description: Reference to the User who submitted the ticket

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: Reference to the User (agent) assigned to handle the ticket

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was created

relationships.description: Ticket is submitted by a User
Ticket is assigned to an agent User
